## Summary

This is the Spring PetClinic REST project using the OfficeFloor framework. The response DTO you'll edit (`OwnerDto`) is **generated at build time** from an OpenAPI spec, so adding `telephoneDisplay` means editing (a) the OpenAPI spec and (b) the MapStruct mapper — not a hand-written DTO. There is **no libphonenumber dependency**; E.164 handling is done by a small hand-written utility.

---

### 1. The response DTO with `telephone` — `OwnerDto` (GENERATED)

There is no hand-written `OwnerResponse`/`OwnerDto` source file. The DTO is generated by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` into package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto` (class `OwnerDto`, and `OwnerFieldsDto` for the request body). See `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml` lines 368-411:
- `inputSpec`: `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
- `modelPackage`: `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`
- `modelNameSuffix`: `Dto`
- Output: `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` (not yet built — `target` is empty)

The DTO's shape is defined entirely by the schema in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**:
- `OwnerFields` schema (lines 1991-2077) — the request/editable fields, including `telephone` (lines 2026-2033): `type: string`, pattern `^[0-9]*$`, maxLength 20.
- `Owner` schema (lines 2078-2223) — `allOf: [OwnerFields, {id, displayName, initials, customerCode, ...}]`. All the extra owner-only fields here are `readOnly: true`. **This is where a new `telephoneDisplay` readOnly property must be added** (alongside `displayName`, `initials`, etc. around lines 2093-2104).

`telephone` appears ONLY in the Owner/OwnerFields schemas (confirmed by grep across the whole spec) — not in Pet, Vet, Visit, or any other schema.

### 2. The Owner entity and base class

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `Owner extends Person`. Telephone is stored here (not in the base class):
```java
@Column(name = "telephone")
@NotEmpty
@Pattern(regexp = "^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message = "Phone number must be in E.164 format")
private String telephone;   // line 47-50
```
Getter/setter at lines 106-112. Note the entity enforces **E.164** (`+` then 8-15 digits). The `Person` base class (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`) holds `firstName`/`lastName` only — not telephone.

### 3. Other DTOs/classes with a telephone field

None. Telephone exists only on the Owner side: the `Owner` entity, the generated `OwnerDto`/`OwnerFieldsDto`, and the JDBC repositories' SQL (owners table). Pet and Vet DTOs/schemas have no telephone.

### 4. How the response DTO is constructed — MapStruct mapper

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — a MapStruct `@Mapper` interface. `toOwnerDto(Owner)` (lines 27-36) maps the entity to `OwnerDto`, with derived read-only fields supplied via `@Mapping(target = ..., expression = "java(...)")` calling `default` helper methods in the same interface (e.g. `displayName`, `initials`, `membershipNumber`, `locality`). **This is where you add `@Mapping(target = "telephoneDisplay", expression = "java(telephoneDisplay(owner))")` plus a `default String telephoneDisplay(Owner owner)` method.** `telephone` itself is mapped implicitly by name.

The mapper is invoked in three response functions:
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java` (GET) — `response.send(ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner))`
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (POST, 201)
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` (PUT)

### 5. Existing tests asserting telephone in JSON

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` (the only telephone JSON assertion) — this test already expects the new field:
```java

int id = createOwnerOk(o);
getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.telephone").value("+61412345678"))
        .andExpect(jsonPath("$.telephoneDisplay").value("+61 412 345 678"));
```
The class doc (lines 7-9) specifies the format: `telephoneDisplay` = stored E.164 formatted as country code, space, then national digits grouped in threes; raw `telephone` stays E.164. So `+61412345678` → `+61 412 345 678`.

Test helpers live in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` (`ownerNode()`, `getOwner(id)`, `createOwnerOk(...)`, `uniqueTelephone()` at line 102).

`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`. **libphonenumber (com.googlecode.libphonenumber) is NOT a dependency, and no phone-formatting library is present.** Relevant deps: Spring Boot starters, OfficeFloor (`officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` 4.0.2), MapStruct 1.6.3, `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` 7.23.0, Jackson, json-path. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When present it must be a valid
            postcode for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099);
            a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth (ISO). Optional; when present the derived ageBand is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, bypasses the household-duplicate block so this owner can be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the new owner is recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only directive; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' - the region derived from the postcode and the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn (mod 10) check digit computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived from the owner's own fields, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household - the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name followed by '|' and the postcode. Assigned automatically to every owner, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it.
              type: string
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (telephone in E.164, email lower-cased, each component empty when absent). Two
                owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Derived from the owner's own fields - starts at 1; add 1 when an email is present;
                add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); capped at 3. Level 4 is
                reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's postcode range (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) - the same REGION that forms the customerCode -
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from the owner's
                own fields - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been registered on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The age band derived from the owner's birthDate measured against their
                registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over; absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone;
                otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold) is
                never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone); absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
